profile.title: Senior Freelance Frontend Engineer
profile.summary: Senior freelance frontend developer with 10+ years of experience building large-scale web applications and digital platforms for enterprise, public-sector, and agency clients. Specialised in React, Next.js, Vue, TypeScript, frontend architecture, accessibility, and performance optimisation.

freelance.availability: Available for freelance projects and long-term collaborations

projectSupplements.details: Freelance engagement via Scholz & Volkmer GmbH for Deutsche Bahn (March 2024 – February 2026). Software used by service staff to inform travelers about train connections, delays, and related updates. Christian implemented Vue-based components, performed bug-fixing, and integrated APIs. Also built with TypeScript across desktop, mobile, customer displays, and dedicated hardware terminals.

Freelance engagement via Scholz & Volkmer GmbH (June 2025 – September 2025). German Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF) initiative focused on environment and sustainability. Developed a Vue/Nuxt web app combined with physical sensors as a toolkit for citizens without formal academic training. Christian led initial frontend setup and visualised sensor data from a Directus backend on maps using MapTiler and Leaflet.
React, TypeScript, and TanStack Query management platform for monitoring production equipment and scheduling maintenance in a large-scale dairy manufacturing environment.
Built scalable React frontend components and AEM templates for BMW's corporate platform.
Led frontend architecture on Liferay, delivering reusable portal components in close collaboration with design and backend teams.
Frontend lead for the mobile web launch experience. Led the swipeable mobile version of an HTML scrollpage with fullscreen imagery and device-independent usage.
Contributed to the official McDonald's Germany iOS application. The app reached more than 2 million downloads and ranked among the top 15 most downloaded iPhone apps in Germany in 2012.
Led frontend development for national campaigns including Do-Your-Own-Coupons, Mexify Yourself, Blend-in-Cup, and Big Mac Hunt.

webShop.title: Ecommerce Platform
webShop.summary: Designed and built Caravano, a multi-tenant ecommerce platform for creating and managing fully branded online stores. The platform brings together storefronts, products, content, orders, payments, shipping, localisation, and administration in one system. AI-assisted store and product composers let merchants describe what they want in natural language and turn those descriptions into structured, editable storefronts and product content. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Payload CMS, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare R2, and Stripe. Separates the AI composition layer from the underlying commerce platform so generated content stays editable and the core models remain independent from how content is created — easier to extend with new storefront capabilities, integrations, and AI workflows. Live platform: https://caravano.app/ (Danish at /da; German at /de).

features.title: AI Store Composer
features.description: A natural-language store composer turns a short description of a business into a structured starting point for the storefront, including content, styling, and store configuration.

features.title: AI Product Composer
features.description: Product information can be transformed into structured product content, helping merchants create listings faster while keeping the generated content editable and under their control.

features.title: Storefront & Branding
features.description: Flexible storefront configuration supports branding, typography, colours, layouts, content blocks, responsive experiences, and custom domains, allowing each store to have its own identity.

features.title: Products & Content
features.description: Products, variants, categories, pricing, media, pages, and content are managed through a unified administration interface with drafts and preview before publishing.

features.title: Commerce & Checkout
features.description: Cart, favourites, guest checkout, customer accounts, orders, discounts, and Stripe-powered payments provide the core shopping experience without relying on a collection of separate apps.

features.title: Payments & Operations
features.description: Stripe Connect provides merchant-specific payment accounts and direct payouts, while transactional email, order management, and shipping integrations support the operational side of running a store.

features.title: Internationalisation
features.description: Multi-language storefronts support English, Danish, German, and Spanish, with configurable currencies, VAT settings, shipping zones, and translation workflows built into the platform.

technology.intro: The platform is engineered around technologies chosen for maintainability, performance, flexibility, and a strong developer experience, while keeping the architecture practical for a growing SaaS product.
technology.closing: The architecture spans multi-tenant ecommerce, AI-assisted content generation, content management, payments, media storage, internationalisation, third-party integrations, and deployment infrastructure.

product.summary: Caravano separates the AI composition layer from the underlying commerce platform, keeping generated content editable and the core models independent from the way content is created. This architecture makes the system easier to extend as new storefront capabilities, integrations, and AI workflows are introduced, without making generated content or predefined templates the centre of the platform. From the AI composition layer to the storefront, administration interface, and underlying services, Caravano is built as one extensible product.
